t: Yes, that's where I came from. We were glad to receive the invitations from the elves. I didn't come here alone. We are many! We listen to the sweet voices of the Muses, so we heeded the plea of the god Dionisius and decided to help with whatever the Mage named Caspar is plotting!

I'm happy to see that you have a chance to take part in the deeds of the people so capable, gifted, and talented! We were glad to receive the invitations from the elves. I didn't come here alone. We are many! We listen to the sweet voices of the Muses, so we heeded the plea of the god Dionisius and decided to help with whatever the Mage named Caspar is plotting!

You have probably never been in Lightwood. Everyone there plays the bagpipes! We're the Whistle Family: Mjolle, Vagajr, and Ygujl. We love music and everything connected with it. We decided to take part the moment we heard about the elf's idea.

Oh well. Why not? I was the best trumpeter back at home, on New Igsh! I played the wake-up tune near the City Council every day! Diddy-diddy, diddy-dum! You understand, don't you? We can't miss the chance to show the world that we're capable of something!
May your day be good, friend!

Why not? My name is Pelagiy Guslarov, I am the best story teller on the Hangah allod. I collect ancient legends and folk tales, and sing ditties. I was honored to receive an invitation to Irene. It is with pleasure that I'll wine and dine at the feast! Since the masters are so generous, why not help them?
The trick is to keep up the rhythm and hit the drum as hard as you can.

I got bored sitting around on Eljune in Takalik Harbor and doing nothing. I hear elves are throwing a Ball! Sending out invitations and stuff. So I packed my things, and came here. They have, like, everything here: booze and chicks, it's so much fun!

Your mug looks familiar. Have we met?

I know! On Eljune!

I remember you! Remember how we rocked at our concert after the King and Jester band left? Did you know I was left there alone? I missed my ship after the party.

But that's nothing! I heard about the Ball, packed my stuff, and came here. They have, like, everything here: booze and chicks, it's so much fun!
Aho, frriend! May the ancestorrs bless you.

I am! Rright from Howlem! I've always wanted to be a rrock starr. I couldn't miss this. I say, this is an unusual place. Do you sense anything? I have a feeling that someone's watching us. Some spirrits of this place.

Sure thing! I've always wanted to give a public performance. I didn't have a chance to make a really big concert at Xadagan. My kin is pretty reserved. What's the point in making a concert if the audience shows no emotions?
Greetings, . You have come to the Great House de Grandeur. My name is Baudouin de Grandeur, I'm the vice-head of this House and the Great Mage of the Stellar allod!
It's good to see you, . You're at the residence of the Great House de Pluie. My name is Guillaume de Pluie. I am at both the head of the House and the Great Mage of the Tempesta allod!
The League doesn't good look, for sure. But you're wrong to expect me to jump for joy. Some day I'll be back, and I'll burn everything down.
It's better than your prison, but that's obvious.
My butterfly collection! I'm nothing without it.

I'm enraged! I'm a renowned lepidopterologist! They locked me up in prison and took away my collection! They fed me scraps and pigwash! The war has to end. The elves must stop getting involved in someone else's affairs!
What? Here? It's not bad. Not bad at all! Beautiful scenery. Unlike the grey landscape of Igsh I'm used to. I think I've seen a new butterfly species.
Hmm... did they let you in here? Unwise...
The League tried to free us while the Empire was messing things difficult for them... and you helped them! If Yasker thinks we're too stupid to see through his deception... I feel sorry for him.
It's wonderful. My mind and body are relaxing after your prison. And look at all the beautiful girls!
Hey there! Your face is familiar! How are you doing?

Oooh, it was so rude of the League! I expected to be rescued, even imagined a knight on a shiny... dreadnought! But they simply forgot about me! But you freed me. That's something. Come over tonight. I'll thank you properly!
I've always dreamed about the Great Ball! I had to skip the previous one. I was too young. Oh, but this one is so much fun! I'm glad they invited you.

Just like my House, I'm interested in alchemy. Combat alchemy, of course. Why else would the Empire have taken me prisoner? I study explosives, choking gas, et cetera. All this mana energy is quite interesting, but trust me, alchemy has many secrets, too. Today we use gunpowder to blow things up, but if... ugh, it's top secret, I can't tell you that.
Another gawker, great. What do you want?
Oh, really. You know what? Stick your apologies where the sun doesn't shine. You didn't try hard enough.
What's it to you? It's way more fun than the Imperial prison, of course.

Isn't it obvious? I'm a lepidopterologist. I study butterflies. I even had a collection that I carelessly took with me on a journey. An Imperial cruiser intercepted our ship. I ended up in prison and lost my collection. I was humiliated, insulted, and mistreated! Now I'm trying to regain my mental equilibrium here on Irene.
My butterfly collection! I'm nothing without it.

This is outrageous! The war has to end. The elves must stop getting involved in someone else's affairs! Just think of it! I'm a renowned lepidopterologist! They locked me up in prison and took away my collection! They fed me scraps and pigwash!
On Irene? It's not that bad. I think I spotted another undiscovered butterfly. Beautiful scenery. Unlike the grey landscape of Igsh I'm used to.

Hmm. I'm a professional scout. I used to recruit agents on Igsh. I was caught, arrested, and sent to prison. Now I need to figure out what to do next. I might use the Hall of Changes: dye my hair, change my face, or even become a lovely lady for the time being, hehe. But holidays first.
I'm glad to see the League's renowned hero!

I know they've been trying. They dropped off their troops on Igsh, captured the XAES... it's a shame it didn't work! But I guess there's only so many battles you can win. If the plan worked, we would have won the war. The way things went... well, there was peace and the anti-architectural alliance.
Wonderful! Just look at all the beautiful girls! My mind and body are relaxing after the Imperial prison.

I'm pretty noble by blood! I'm Caspar de Vevre's second cousin once removed! Now that I'm free, I'm thinking of writing an autobiography. I'll write down everything I've been through! "Humiliated and Insulted" will be its title. It should be quite a volume.
Hey there! I don't know you in person, but I've heard a lot. How are you?

Oooh, it was so rude of the League! They were supposed to save me! But they simply forgot about me! It was so humiliating! Me, an aristocrat, in the hands of arrogant Imperial rabble!

I remember fantasizing about being captured... tied and slowly undressed... it seemed so hot! That wasn't what happened in real life. I was freezing in prison, and the food was bad.
Oh, it's fun! I'm glad they invited you. I've always dreamed about the Great Ball! I had to skip the previous one. I was too young. I'm glad to finally be here, after everything that happened.

You know, if your life is long, which is the case with us elves, and your passion is everlasting... your love bears certain fruits. My beloved daughters are the fruits of love. Souvenirs from men I fell in love with.
Greetings, my dear friend. What brings you here?

Oh, sweet Louis, always full of secrets. The king is my good friend, so I'm always willing to help you. And so are my lovely daughters. You and your friend can count on my hospitality.

Have you visited the Rose and Hibiscus?

Oh, you should! Get settled in my residence and visit it. You can ask me or my daughters any questions. You can ask at least those girls that are here. Hmm... I wonder where the little Iris is. What are the guards doing?

Some rules they've got here! This place means business, I can tell.

I wonder if they'll even let me in, huh.
The inscription on the frontal page goes, "This is private property of Iris de Delice. No one can read it but the owner."

I find all this very disturbing. I need to talk to Gala and maybe Cantor about what's happening. Hardly anyone will trust me, I'm afraid. If I'm right, we're in grave danger.

[There's a note between the last pages of the diary]

My dear Iris! I was astonished to learn you're gathering information about me. No offence, honey, but I need you to send over everything you've got so far, otherwise the consequences will be very unpleasant. Neither I nor His Eminence would want that.

Sincerely yours, E.

It's pretty creepy. I don't know what to do now. I can leave my shard, because I'm not allowed to show up in the "upper society". Well, I guess it's time for a sweet candy! No one will go looking and no one will ask for names since everything is in plain sight.
We've been very busy since that nasty cardinal started pestering us! Aurora is on Ignis, Beata is back there on Al Rihat, and poor me is in charge. I'm the eldest. My head is spinning!
Hm. Zizi is a super important person. He never tells anyone where she's going and with whom. She could at least share her boys!
She loves heroes, you know – the type that can erect a flag on top of an enemy fortress. Yeah. I guess she's with one of them.
You can't tell, but deep down they're nervous. You know, de Desirae could forget about it if Roxane gives up her rights on Nocturne.

The vampires will probably stay in Amarantha unless Catherina objects. You know, we have a plan to relocate all the undead to a separate allod. I think it's named Jigran. Marianna Lopatina has recently rediscovered it. The elven part of House de Douceur is likely to reside on the Nea allod.
Oh, a familiar face. I knew we'd meet soon.

Yep. It's Iris. Poor thing, life was harsh on her. That's why she's doing strange things now. Her reputation is ruined. Any appearance among the noble can trigger a scandal. What else is she supposed to do? I mean, other that participating in questionable affairs. Poor thing.
I know a man has courted her... You know, de Vevre, the war hero? He doesn't care much about reputation, so... perhaps, he's Zizi's best option.
Glory to the arch-duchess, the eternally beautiful, wise, and generous patroness!
Oh, right! Iris. I haven't been following her. She's got a lot of weird ideas. You know, after what happened on Igsh.
The girls always have some maids around. Sweet servants who always know who goes where and with whom.

Yep, that's me. I mean, no! No! There's also Zoe, but she's a baby. So that makes me what, the second youngest daughter? I'm a, you know, an adult, all grown-up and responsible! That's me! Now I'm babbling. I'm sorry. It's just that... I'm your fan, and here you are, in all your glory! And I lost it. Kind of. What am I saying? I lost it! Sorry.
Oh, I can't believe it's really you! I'm seeing you with my own eyes!

Erm... No. Wait. Give a moment... I can't believe I've met you in person.

I'm so excited I'm going to puke!

Phew, that was close.

Whee! Is it really you? Can I touch you?

Um... Do you mean Zizi? Or Iris? I've seen her with... no, I can't tell you. Although you must know... those who fought the architects? You must have dealt with them, too, so you know enough... Oh Tensess! What am I saying? It's so embarrassing.

Thanks for asking. Everything's in order. War changes people... We survived many things. We lost many. Some comrades remained on the battlefield. I see them in my dreams. I'm questioning myself – why did I survive when they died?
Hey, buddy! I didn't expect to meet you here on Irene. Do you remember... How we captured that stronghold? Those were the days.
That's right. Who told you? Yes, I'm courting Iris. She's a sweet girl, even though she's been through a lot.
I have no idea. She disappeared quite suddenly. She left all her things behind, at home. I'm very worried about her. This allod only looks safe. Something's going to happen.

Oh traveler! You are standing before the gates that lead to eternal joy! Everyone that enters should know: your wishes are heard! You will find here what you have been looking for!

What are you looking for?
We don't disclose information about our visitors. Overly intrusive and prying individuals shall be banned.

Pfft, right. It's great that it's over. I'm tired of hiding in that filthy IMD and feeding on fried termites and other junk. When Ignat Petrovin was arrested and sent to the Suslanger camp, it became really boring.

I'm free, no thanks to the League. I'm tired of hiding in that filthy IMD and feeding on fried termites and other junk. When Ignat Petrovin was arrested and sent to the Suslanger camp, it became really boring. I'm a little grateful to the Imperials now that it's over, although I understand that their reasons were purely diplomatic.
Hello, heroes! Have you seen a ladybug around? I've seen one. I really like ladybugs. Some day I want to become one.
Iris? Yes, I know a little. I'm her servant. Her and her sisters'. Iris is weird. No wonder! After everything she's been through! It could have happened to me.
No. I know for sure that none of the sisters saw Iris before she disappeared.

Hello there! Here you are, . Want see a local specialty? Huh! They say de Delice have something that no one has ever seen here before.

Hey, what's with the face? The king and his missions again, eh? What are they after, huh? Go on, spit it out.
Women are nothing but trouble. Let's just ask her directly.

Ugh, the knife-eared and their scheming! I hate the way they drag you into their intrigues.

Well, a low profile it is, then. I'm not good at it, though, so you'll do the talking. In the meantime, I'll scan their brains and find out what they're truly thinking. Afterwards, I'll wipe this conversation from their memories. So you'll be in the clear.

How do you like the idea?

Such a responsibility would be too much for me. There are a lot of independent vampire families scattered throughout Sarnaut. They don't obey me. You know, I think we can make a deal. Apart from the offer of amnesty (if it's approved by the Great Houses), we also have a vaccine. We can't have it before Nihaz is dealt with, but still...
We're pouring happiness in glasses! What happiness are you looking for today?
I can't say no to Sweet Candy! My best cocktail for the most charming lady. On the house.
Just go, don't look around. I'll take care of it.

Hah! Hey hop!

How is it going? Did Iris tell you something?
That's what I call a party! Elves aren't boring at all, hehe.

Well, who's entering the garden of pleasures today?

Listen to your heart, it's calling out your true name!

Sounds great!

Now let's find you an outfit. Try on our suggestion. We wouldn't want to bore you with fittings and measurements on your first visit here.

Do you like it?

You can try on a different outfit if you like.

Wonderful! You look quite alluring.

The door of our garden is open for you. Step inside and find Beauty and Pleasure.

Enjoy your stay!

Welcome to the Rose and Hibiscus, the garden of pleasures. Is this your first visit?

Before you dive into the sea of pleasures, let me tell you about our house rules.

The Rose and Hibiscus is the place where we hang out and enjoy beauty. All flowers of our garden are equally beautiful. Each is worthy of attention and respect. By entering this door, you agree to leave your former self behind. This place knows no factions, Houses, or faces. There are only masks and nicknames. True names must be respected and never revealed. And of course, there's no room for weapons and armor that hide the true beauty of Nature's creation.

Follow these simple rules, and you will enjoy true pleasure in our beautiful garden.
What a surprise! I didn't expect to see you here. Thanks for helping me back there.
It's you! I thought you looked familiar... but I didn't expect to see you here. Thanks for helping me back there.

Ha! Money makes the world go round. I could steal something from the Bunker. I talked to the local smugglers. Of course, I had to spend a week in your underground water supply system. But then I got on board of the ship to Avilon, and finally arrived at Novograd. I wish I were a writer, I could write a book. Nice talking to you, but I need to go.
I'm used to different clubs. This one feels like home. That's strange...
There I am! Who are you? I can't recognize you in this mask, darling. I don't do private dance, mind you.
Wow! What does His Majesty want with a humble person such as myself?

What a generous offer. As if I were looking to return to the company of hypocrites, who show their bravery only while wearing masks. On the other hand... I have something to tell him. There's a conspiracy on Irene. We're all in danger.
Say I believed you. But first, I need a drink. Can you bring me a cocktail? I need to pull myself together.

You must be under the guise of Ardent Love to enter the Garden of Pleasures. Thing is, our visitors are hiding their identities. This allows them to feel relaxed and not fear the consequences. A pleasure is only a pleasure when you don't have to pay a price. Those wanting to enter must contribute by purchasing this mask from a hostess, who controls the gifts of our beautiful and generous arch-duchesse.
I can offer it to you for a certain sum of ecu. But as a special guest, you can also borrow it for me for a time.

It's curious. It means, Renard gives Eurial assignments? At this stage, it looks like traditional intrigues before the Big Game. Of course, the girl must not suffer. However, I know the Cardinal. I'm sure she'll be locked up for a while, that's all. I'm curious about his minion, though.
Oh Tensess, why so aggressive? I'm just a mage and potions master from the House de Vevre who has not been officially invited to the Galleon. So I've been hiding in invisibility...

I noticed you were having fun and couldn't help myself. I agree that this ball needs more entertainment!

But you're so boring about it. Just drinking until you fall over in the middle of the ballroom!

I have a few potions... I can guarantee you will enjoy yourselves more if you try them! I and my allies from the House de Vevre use them often...
I really doubt no one would notice that! I have powerful hooves, we'll be as loud as a storm!
I don't see any other centaurs or minotaurs giving people rides.
Fine! But I can't carry both of you, I'm not that strong!
Alright, but... There's nowhere to go, it's too packed.  I was barely able to enter the room.
What is this spell? Never heard of it!
I wouldn't want to embarrass myself by toppling over and dropping you!
I'm not a hare! They have two legs, and they are good at jumping.
Fine, if they are so fast, why not give it a try?
What if we run someone over? We'll have to get a healer, and we'll have to answer for that!

Skulnar? Hmm... as the new queen, I'm concerned about the disappearance of people in my domain.

Then I'll tell you what happened. The three of you tried to get Louis to have food brought to the second floor of the Galleon - the poor man did his best to pretend he wasn't seeing you!

And then you started acting like you were riding something... What? What centaur? Ancient Moon? Here, at the Ball? It sounds like you weren't just drinking last night...

As a result, you and your friends were sent to some waiter... Where is he? Ah, there he is, near the entrance!

I remember you leaving the room and then returning with this waiter and food, but without Skulnar. I assumed he stayed outside to clear his head...
! Let me guess: your head is killing you, and you don't remember anything?

Oh, I see you're not as interested in music anymore. I hope the same goes for your friend, because I'm really tired of this...

Yesterday you came here to make music, but after a few... unsuccessful attempts decided that the instrument was the problem - or so I was told.

You found the only musician with access to the warehouse - me, that is - and forced him to keep bringing you new harps - either the tone was wrong, or string texture, or the color...

But you were trying to create art! How could I refuse you?

But an hour later, I did.
You went to the third floor, grabbing some loud people and a Gibberling family on the way, while me and a couple of other waiters were cleaning up here... They should be somewhere on the third floor.
Before your first fans showed up? Yes, I'd say so. You and your musical Priden friend.

You and your friend... I remember you... Where is that ignorant orc? I'll tell him straight to his face what I think of him...!

If he's sober, that is...

What, you don't remember? How could you forget such boorishness!

This... Skulnar tried to make me paint his portrait, but I told him that elven beauty is the only thing I work with.

Then he took away my paints and said he'd paint a self-portrait! And started painting right over my new masterpiece!

I tried to stop him but couldn't even move his hand...
How would I know... A minute after the orc finished abusing my painting, I heard shouting from the central hall!

NO! I'll burn it and bury the ashes on Umoir!

Ah, art is helpless before brute strength... Unless it's a martial art, of course.
...I told you, there's enough food on Galleon to feed half of Kania!
Ah, there you are! Slept well? Where's your huge inspiring friend?

Oh, I remember that well!

You and your friends managed to eat all the food on our floor, and then came to us and started asking if we were hiding anything else.

When Skulnar, as he introduced himself, realized there was no food here, he delivered a long speech that any party should have twice the amount of food needed to feed everyone!

Well, you went downstairs to look for food there. Afterwards, judging by the noise, you went somewhere on this floor to play the harps...

And my colleague was so inspired by this Skulnar's speech that he has spent the last few hours trying to convince me to rethink the guest experience at the Galleon so this never happens again! What an idiot!
...We can't leave it like this! We are the staff of the Galleon, we must respond to such complaints and do our best to ensure that this never happens again!
Oh, you're here! Where's your big friend? I could use his help...

How so? Don't you remember how the three of you came to us to find out where else you can get food on our floor, because you ate everything else?

And what a shame, we couldn't help you with that, so we just sent you back down...

But Skulnar's speech inspired me! I won't leave it like that, it won't happen again! I'll become the Galleon's steward if I have to!

You went downstairs, and then you returned - to satisfy your spiritual hunger, apparently, if the peculiar music I heard coming from one of the rooms was anything to go by...

My colleague and I have been arguing ever since that the situation needs to be resolved. Overcoming his resistance is the first step! I can do it!
The elf is unconscious. He keeps muttering, "Of course, of course I can paint his portrait... Of course..."
AHHH! Don't touch me, I can't crawl on ceilings!

Hmm, you sound normal today... I'll tell you if you stop touching me.

Yesterday I sobered up sometime towards the end of the binge on the second floor, but you didn't... You dragged me here and tried to throw my whole family at the ceiling. It was funny at first...

I didn't see any, which is good - we'd probably be a smear on the ceiling by now... So you lost someone, too? Once I'm fully awake, I'll look for my family. Maybe they're on the Galleon's roof. You're lucky I don't hold grudges...

You should ask someone on the second floor. They definitely remembered you there, and you made quite a mess...
The Zem is unconscious. You notice that his legs are slightly damaged. It looks like someone tried to use tools on them... Why?
Yes? Since Skulnar is your friend, I can tell you. They went to the pier near the Palace. That's all I know.
I'll take a break for parties for the next year...

Happened...? So many things happened! Should I tell you how you tried to throw Gibberlings at the ceiling, or how you tried to check if it was possible to unscrew a Zem's leg in field conditions?

But... I don't remember any of your friends... But there was a Priden, a handsome one...

Oh, why are you bothering me with this? Yesterday was much more fun... If you want to interrogate someone, go interrogate your friend, he must be somewhere nearby. The last time I saw him, he couldn't walk anymore...
What can I do for... Ah, it's you! So Skulnar hasn't returned yet?
You don't sound as friendly now... Fine, we're friends now, we understand each other. You can tell me about any of your problems!

Well… you came here to get food. I sent my guys to get some, and we were waiting for them at the entrance. We talked, I told you about my family...

Then Eurial showed up. I've never seen her this close before. You got really angry at first, I wondered if you two had a past... You know...

Then you two got friendly. She said that Skulnar didn't look well, although to me he looked fine, just drunk - but in this state, you were easy to convince... She said she knew an excellent healer who would help him, and that Skulnar would return to you in half an hour.

They went somewhere on the pier, and we stayed here waiting for the food...
You should have said so! Now I see why you're so concerned! No, I saw neither Eurial nor Skulnar, but they could only take a gondola from here. I think you know where to go now...

What are you on about?

...Ah, I know! Is this your new role? So emotional and expressive! You need to rehearse some more, and then we'll talk about our new play.
The local boatman didn't see anything, I already asked him! But we'll find Skulnar without him.
Let's use our biggest advantage - my nose. I can pick up his trail as soon as you ask me to.
I'll have to explain everything to my agents... HOW could we let this happen?!
I'm with you, ...! Besides, when this is over, someone has to tell the queen how it all happened...
It looks like you've almost figured it out...

A special ritual that will help us all if you do not interfere. I can't tell you the details, but I'm sure Elleken will tell you everything once he's done.

This story has been going on for a thousand years, and soon it will come to an end!

I suggest you don't spill blood needlessly. We are not enemies and not even villains, . It's just that few understand... our goals.
Yes, he'll stay alive and well as long as no one interferes. I wouldn't mind if you just stood there, but one wrong move...

Well, suit yourself. We have fought once. I won't underestimate you this time!

Just tell your friends to stay out of it. Let's keep this... between us.

Well, suit yourself. We have fought once. I won't underestimate you this time!

Just tell your friends to stay out of it. Let's keep this... between us.
Secret passages! Right here, under our land...! I mean, the future queen Antoinette's land, of course.
I don’t understand... how did they fit everything inside...? How much is there?

Zvik! Zvik!

Now I'm the smart one! I know what to do. The Traveler told me what to do!

You and I will talk! Zvik!

I can't let you pass! But if you turn around and leave, I'll forgive you for killing my subjects!

I won't kill you when the Kobolds capture Irene again!
A mighty hero showed up, just as the Traveler promised! You smell like blood... Zvik, zvik! But I can't let you pass!

Well, I knew Louis was plotting something... His plan to give the orcs a Great Mage to weaken the Empire sounds rather risky.
It's no wonder Lucretia tried to put an end to this as soon as she got wind of it. She risked a lot when she sent George to Ferris with the Dragon Bond - no one knew what she was trying to accomplish. And Elleken's daughter Eurial went after him.

So the orc Horde will be revived? I'm not sure I like this scenario. Their Great Feast, the cult of strength and brutality... It's not what we need right now.

I suppose I should assist the Empire with this issue. I want to unite, not separate.
The hero returns victorious! You must be used to it by now.

Yes, the king did contact Elleken. Don't look at me like that: he just promised to make Skulnar a Great Mage, and it was necessary.

That whole performance with the theatre, however, was distasteful. They must be mad. They believe we turned our backs on our ideals, forgot about the Beauty in our pursuit of Pleasure. But that's not true!
It seems we averted all the troubles at this Great Ball. No one died, no one turned into a vampire.

If you have questions regarding our actions, remember our lessons. We told you: without orcs, who are the lifeblood of the Imperial war machine, Xadagan is not a threat!

The best path to peace is to stop the war before it begins. Other Heads of the Houses will agree with me. Albert and Baudouin, for example. Once Antoinette became our ruler, these two apparently forgot about Our quarrel. The House de Desirae is gaining allies again.

Together, We will present our terms to the League. There will be no war with the Empire. Don't even think about taking advantage of its vulnerability!

That way we'll put an end to all wars in no time.
We can see by your face that Elleken told you everything... Well... We had to keep some things from you for the good of everyone.

Yes, we always get drawn into some ancient mysteries... Just like on Ferris! I feel bad for Skulnar, we only recently met on Coldberg. He's a great guy, eysh!

Alright, we'll rest a bit here, and then I'll go back to Ferris. They are preparing another expedition. Don't forget your old friend Murk, you hear me? You'll call me if something interesting happens, right?
Aho, friends! I'm glad you made it!
! You are both here... What happened?

I suspected Elleken had something to do with that, but I didn't know what he was plotting.

Journeys to another world? Well, Catherina and Ollum will definitely be interested. But there's a small problem: there are no Star Gates left in this world, they turned into dust when we sent the Architect through them.

Not to mention the fact that you'll need a map first. A navigator is useless without a route.

Elleken is right about one thing: there are monsters beyond the barrier that separates Sarnaut from other worlds. We have already seen the Architects. I'm certain there are other hostile creatures in that endless space.

Elleken is extremely powerful - even my powers weren't enough to breach his defenses. Unless I had drown power from the Well, but then the consequences could have been disastrous. Experience means a great deal - I might be old, but compared to him, I'm just a greenhorn.

I could only pinpoint a potential exit point from these catacombs.

Elleken will bide his time. He has done what he planned, and now Skulnar has no other choice but to complete the Great Mage training. Otherwise his new powers will destroy him.

As I said, without the Star Gates or anything that can replace them, we can't even begin to consider leaving Sarnaut. But the first Great Mage knows how to wait. He is patient, so... If the new Gates do appear, we'll have something to worry about.

As for Skulnar... I feel sorry for him, he didn't choose this path. He needs to be trained... But no one in the Empire will do it. The League won't do it either.

So I have no choice but to try and make him a Great Mage myself. That would be... uncommon.

Skulnar is not the only one Elleken abandoned here. We have his daughter, Eurial. Soon I'll take them both to the allod of the Nea Historians. I will train Skulnar there and see if I can make our "viper" change her views.
You can speak with the rest if you like. Come find me once you're done. I'll send you and Skulnar to get some rest, while I... discuss what happened with everyone involved.

That's correct. But I believe His Majesty has questions about what happened... As do everyone here. Let's spare them a few minutes before we leave, if you don't mind.

Ready to leave and get some rest?

It's the result of my experiment! You have probably figured out a few things. I'll tell you the rest.

You and I are quite similar. I used to be one of those who are now called Great Mages. I wanted the best for my people. Our ideals of Beauty required that we change the world... But then we met dragons and realized we were not perfect. I was one of those who planned the Change.

As you can imagine, we failed to accomplish that. Nemeina and I wanted to keep trying. But everyone else was against it. The dispute culminated in our departure from Irene.

What is it you think we have in common? Just like you, I received a Revelation of Nihaz. I realized that this world is a prison! There are other worlds full of the primordial, true Beauty!

It's simple. To get to other worlds, we need Star Gates! But traveling between worlds is dangerous... The space is inhabited by creatures so hideous your imagination would fail to draw you a picture. We need a navigator for traveling between worlds. The one who will infallibly pick the safe path.

My experiments showed me that an orc would be a perfect candidate for the role. This race, forgive my frankness, is rather dull, but their intuition is rarely wrong. There's only one problem: the navigator must be a mage, and not just any mage, but a Great one. And the orcs' magical powers are lacking, as you know.

Then I remembered my Key of Creation. One of the artifacts Nihaz left in the world. By then, Grallon had the key, but you already know this story.

I got the Key and went to the Grok allod. The Great Mage Claude de Vevre was once a student of mine, and unlike the other members of the Conclave, he had a rather liberal view on what was considered forbidden. Together with Nemeina and our daughter Eurial, we chose an orc and used the powers of the Key of Creation and the Key of Chaos on him! The result exceeded our expectations!

Of course!

Orcs are a savage people, and Lorzub the Fierce - that was our test subject - went out of control. It turned out he had a lover, and they were about to escape together. Alas, our attempt to get him back resulted in his death. By then, the Conclave got wind of what we were doing, and we had to leave Grok. Claude had the Key of Chaos.

Claude learned that Lorzub had a son. Alas, that line got lost among the Tribe of the Fierce, and Claude's attempts to find the orc who could wield magic ended in failure. Then the Shamans and the Empire heard of it. The Committee has full reports on what happened on Grok - when they killed Claude, they found his notes. But the Empire gains nothing by giving this information to the orcs - that's why they will keep calling it a "random astral mutation".

Before his death, Claude hid the Key of Chaos, and it remained hidden until Grok was destroyed by an Octulhu on the Night of Astral Portals. You know this creature as Ar Kanim. And then you extracted the power of the Key of Chaos, also known as the Key of Astral Iron, from its blood.

End of story? Not quite. Then I learned about Lorzub's descendants... Alas, they died fast. Faster then I could get to them. But then you and that mad Cosmos managed to get Skulnar out, and I'm grateful you did.

Now I needed to bring together Skulnar and dragon blood. Irene was perfect for that. I used my connections with the House de Vevre and made Caspar invite him. His Majesty Louis's help came in handy as well - he, of course, knew everything and saw it as an opportunity to get ahead of the Empire.

I don't care. I need Skulnar only as a potential guide for other worlds.

Oh, don't give me that.

This orc was created with a purpose: he will become a Great Mage. That's his destiny, and you can't escape destiny. Sooner or later, it was bound to happen. I simply decided to hurry things along.

There's still a lot you don't know about the things that take place in our world. Powers that guide you are older than Sarnaut itself. Things happening here are just a part of the Great War. Some day you will learn everything, like I once did. Why Nihaz captured Sarn, why they quarreled, whose daughter the Soul of the World really is, and other important things.

Only then you will have the true freedom of choice and will be able to make it depending on your interests. For now, don't meddle. Master must finish his work.
Sooner or later all secrets turn into revelations.

Oh, I'm so mad!

The schemer, the villain, the despot! He dares to spy on my daughters! This spider has turned Irene in his cobweb! A spy on every corner! A scout behind every fence!

My poor daughters and I are doing everything to bring real peace to the unhappy, broken Sarnaut. But there are still those who want to ruin everything. They hide behind false ideals, they saw hatred, which bears the poisonous fruit of war!

Oh, my poor daughters! You were through so much! My babies... Aurora, Beata, Claire, Diana, Ellen, Fleur, Gala, Hermina, Iris, Justine, Laura, Maude, Nadine, Odetta, Pauletta, Renee, Sandrine, Tiffany, Ulrica, Vitalina, Ivetta, and... what was it... oh, yes, baby Zoe!

What do you want? Peace? Or a continued war with the Empire?

You get me, don't you?

We're bringing closer the moment when peace establishes in Sarnaut! We already reached truce! We settled things with the Empire, demons, architects, even vampires!

The war will be over soon. If House de Delice wins the Big Game, of course.

You're wrong, just like Renard.

We can always come to terms. History knows many examples. Just ask Zayan. Besides, you will see a proof very soon.

I'm not the only one who believes in it. So does Queen Lucretia de Desirae, my best childhood friend.

Enemies? With her? What nonsense. The hen and her chicks aren't worthy of it.

The good of the nation is my top priority. The elven nation, that is. Today our lives are entangled with the League. It means, what is bad for the League, is bad for elves.

Yes, we reached truce with the Empire. At what price? The God of Darkness is a big enough threat. We didn't have a choice. The damned Cosmos also threatened to wipe us out unless we make "friends." What is a friendship worth, when sworn enemies are holding knives behind their backs, ready to stab a "friend" at the first opportunity?

She thinks I'm spying on her. On her and her girls. Ha!

I'm spying on everyone on this allod! Tep knows what's happening here! Especially when they lifted the blockage and let everyone on this allod! See for yourself: the Xadaganians are sending encrypted letters, smaller races are rioting in the city, savage Kobolds are digging in ancient tunnels! Peasant actors are throwing show after show! What an awful mess!

I couldn't do it without my assistant. Lamias? What about them? They used to serve House de Grandeur, but I'm paying them better. They serve me now. They do more good than the noble Aviaks, who are only looking for fights.

Am I wrong, trying to unravel Antoinette's scheming? She wants the Empire to drive a wedge between the League and the elves!

You're so naive! It's weird, coming from a hero!

Peace is possible only when the enemy gives up. I'll believe in peace after I see House de Ardeur banner on Yasker's Tower. The gang must be brought to justice. First the trial, then complete demilitarization, and an irrevocable ban on the Imperial ideology!

Because the other option is the red flag in the sky of Novograd, drills, military lifestyle, and barracks all over, like on Igsh. See? It's one way or the other. There's no third option.

I was thinking the same thing!

A solid hostility is better than fragile peace. We can sign truce all we want, we can negotiate all we like, but the essence can't be changed. The League and Empire have completely different ideologies. We want different things. We have different ideals.

The attempts to find common ground are a waste of time. And for the benefit of the enemy. We're working for the Empire, while the Empire is working for us. I know that. I bribed dozens of Xadaganians generals, hahaha!

We're here for the good of the Empire, !

But an order is an order, right? No temptations can seduce a patriot of the Empire, whose moral is impeccable and goals noble!

It's not as though I always understood the elves, ...

But they know how it's done. We're more used to hay, straw, and manure, and look at this neat place! I'd hate to say goodbye to the elves.
One song per minute! Guild rules! Come back later.
Of course! Two silver coins, and I'll come up with something.
Sure thing. Two silver coins, and everybody will hear it.
Do you want a song? Toss a coin!

"Hello, my dear diary!

I'm Princess Daguta de Dernier. I'll write my thoughts, impressions, and other stuff in you.

Let me introduce myself. You know the name, and as for the rest... I'm a heir to my father, King Grallon, the last of Irene kings. Sadly, my mother died during the Cataclysm, which shattered the world into allods. Irene is now one of the allods, a lonely island, which is floating in deep astral."

"Long time no see, diary!

I guess I need to tell you about my life. Life is hard. I want to find someone truly worthy of me, but it's pretty hard. I met many people, I gave my love to many, but I haven't found an equal.

Unfortunately, each of them has too many cons that I can't deal with. I'm very vulnerable. If I reject someone, I can't stand the sight of him anymore. This would be a big problem if it weren't for my father's loyal servants, always willing to help. And, of course, the endless astral, always willing to accept the rejected man's body...

I continue my search."

"Diary! You won't believe this!

A mysterious unknown stranger has arrived at our allod for the first time in many years. He explained that he managed to find the ancient ways that lead through the astral. Amazing!

If you only knew how pretty he is! How wisely he speaks! He charmed everyone in the palace. Father allowed him to stay, although we didn't know the name of the stranger.

We exchanged a couple of words. He knows more about Irene than all of us combined!

I must earn his love! There's no other way to be!"

"Oh, my diary! Woe is me!

The stranger I wrote about earlier! He's neglecting me! He's very sweet, gentle, and kind, but I simply cannot win his heart!

I don't understand what he wants. Father can't help me. Now that the Stranger brought back the old tradition of Great Balls, it's much more fun on Irene now than it was before. But still, I don't understand why he neglects me! I'm the true treasure of Irene!

It's time for us to talk! Tomorrow! Tomorrow I'll ask him directly why he doesn't like me.

I'm prepared for anything to make him mine!"

"Hello again, my diary!

I'm advised to write more about myself. Here goes. I'm pretty young, according to my people's standards. I was six when the Cataclysm happened. Now it's the twelfth year of the new era. I don't have any siblings. No family at all, except my father. He says we do have a very old next of kin on distant allods. I know nothing about him.

Irene isn't as big as I want it to be. I've learned every corner of it over these years."

"Hello, my dear diary.

As I said, Irene is a pretty small allod. Ker-Is, the capital, is the only city. Years ago, we owned the whole peninsula, with a lot of cities in it: from Tir Toingire to Hay Brezal, from Mag Mell to Aiman Ablah...

It was a fairy land, well protected against any invaders with a magical wall, impassible for anyone with hostile intentions. The Cataclysm ruined almost the entire kingdom. We are the few that lived."

"Hello again, my diary!

I told you that we lived on a small island that was left from our kingdom. We don't have many people here. Only about a thousand elves in the entire capital Ker-Is. I think I know them all in person. How boring!

I read a lot about the past, about the tournaments, balls, and celebrations... Nothing happens nowadays. My father, the king, is still grieving.

But I'm done grieving!"

"Hey, diary, I'm back!

I need someone to complain to. I'm looking for someone worthy of me for a long while, but there isn't anyone. Irene is small. We don't have any equals, and therefore, I'm destined to die alone!

Father doesn't even want to hear about finding me an inferior husband! It's so unfair!

I'm so angry, I'm going to seduce our stable boy!"

"I'm happy to see you again, my diary!

The news is, my father was super angry when he found out about that one time in stables. There was no scandal, though. But I wish there were! I could give him a piece of my mind!

In the meantime, I'm secretly dating my beloved Raul in the nearby forest. Egladien is a beautiful place with a grim history. There was a time when it was called Filthy Forest because of the trolls that lived in the thicket and made an ugly mess of it.

It was in the ancient times. Brave knights got rid of the trolls, anyway."

"Hello, my dear diary!

I'd like to share another story of my life. There was a scandal when my father's servants stumbled upon me and Raul in the forest and reported us to father.

I'll stand my ground: since our remote allod is isolated from the rest of the world, there's nothing left for me to do but make love! Isn't pleasure the point of living for any elf? Father didn't even contradict it. He just gave up.

I'll act as I want. I'll do what I like. No one can order me around any more."

"I'm happy to put down a few lines in you, my dear diary.

Many things happened lately. I don't like the stable boy Raul any longer. He's too annoying, and always jealous of me when I talk with other lovely young men. There are plenty of them in the palace.

I don't want to get upset. What shall I do?"

"We meet again, dear diary!

Here's what happened: I talked to two lovely court squires, Nicolas and Michael. They're brothers, and they're very fun. We talked about a lot of funny things. I complained about the stalking boyfriend, and they promised to help me.

And you know what? They did! They went straight into his room, tied him up, put him in a big bag, and threw him into the astral from a cliff!

It's a bit too much, but I'm afraid, this is the only way out on a small allod, where everyone knows everybody. After all, how could I face him after I dumped him?

The brothers are lovely. I'll thank them... both."
May the Light be with you, !

House de Ardeur is one of the greatest elven Houses. We achieved much, both in glorifying the Lights and in engineering, making a fine example for other elves. Mirage and Galleon Castle are our inventions. Our leaders, siblings Renard and Marianne, are the Heads of the Church of All Elves.

Lumenara is our allod of origin. A bright lighthouse in the astral abyss, an amber-lit shelter for everyone who wants to change this world. Thanks to Renard, all our technical innovations are on this allod, and thanks to the power of Light, it's a truly safe place. We're not alone on the Lumenara allod. The Aviak tribe, our loyal servants, defenders, and assistants inhabit this place.

We respect House de Blizare. We share their passion to exploration and development of this world. House de Desirae are our old friends and allies, who helped us construct the Galleon Palaces. House de Pluie are our trading partners, spare parts suppliers, and supporters in spreading the teachings of the Church of Light.

Our relations with other Houses are not so light. House de Vevre are troublemakers. Too careless to rely on. House de Grandeur are incredibly arrogant, rejecting everything new in life. House de Delice... well, I don't even want to talk about them. Decadence and filth!

Every House has an exception. There's no painting them with a broad brush.

After the Yazes events, I decided to dedicate myself to theoretical theology. Yes... yes! I mean the Master we came across while storming the Gorluxor's Tower. I was especially interested in his Light Side. After all the events, it's very important that we understand the essence of Tensess's Gift. The data was strictly classified, but extremely interesting!

I can send you my work when it's finished.
Oh, beautiful Irene! I've always wanted to visit. Just imagine the scenes I could play here, !

House de Grandeur is truly great. I can't put it in a nutshell. First of all, we're famous for our interest in magic. Magic is everything for us. We even have two Great Mages: brothers Albert and Baudouin. They govern two allods, Lightwood and Stellar. Our House has the biggest number of magisters of magic among elves!

Stellar, our main allod, is covered with a peaceful forest under a vast starry sky. The main elven magic school is located on Stellar. Elves start school in a very young age. The Lightwood allod used to belong to Kania. Today it is the residence of the Gibberlings. We help them settle down, resolve their conflicts with local forest people and Kanians, who still live on the Lightwood allod. Apart from elves, we have lamias on Stellar. We're teaching them magic. We have formed a regiment of magic support under command of a mysterious person...

House de Blizare shares our passion for knowledge. They know almost as much as we do about magic, although they're more passionate... about the practical side. We deeply respect House de Delice, which is always willing to give support. Besides, we respect House de Pluie that helps us with rare magic books and artifacts.

We treat House de Ardeur with caution. They're fanatics. Their "high-end technology" contradicts the ancient teachings of magic! House de Vevre? Too carefree. All they ever want to do is sing songs. House de Desirae members are greedy for power. They're manipulative schemers with sticky fingers.

I have friends in every House, but this has nothing to do with politics.

Oh, you know, we've returned from Howlem just recently, after they stopped hosting theatrical plays. I couldn't possibly miss the Great Ball! No way! There's a bunch of curious stuff this year. So we decided to meet on Irene. It's more fun than the boring Tenebra. Did you know that we had our own theater over here? No one knows the owner's name!
I have a gut feeling, ... Something big is ahead.

About House de Vevre? Not that I'm related to it. I'm a Demon Hunter, we have our own brotherhood. On the other hand, every elf relates to their House, and the ties can't be broken. I'm sure my professional success affects my House.

Ah well. Our House is famous for fine arts. Music, mostly. There are a great many bards in my House. On my allod, we even have a bard academy, which provides professional education in music. I'm not very good at it, so I became an Oracle. But of course, music isn't our only thing. My House is full of great spies. That's where the Oracles can flourish!

Our allod Florenta is always in bloom. There are no other seasons but summer and spring. The allod is covered in flowers and bushes, the aroma is amazing, the bees are buzzing so loudly that you can't hear anything else. We also have harpies, who have been serving the House for many years. We tried to give them everything we own, and thus made them more civilized than any other harpy colony in Sarnaut.

Speaking of official relations and the public opinion, here's what I have to say: House de Blizare is our ally. It's full of highly intelligent elves, pleasant to speak with. House de Delice and us have a mutual affection... as advocates of free love. Of course, there's House de Pluie that deeply appreciates our musical and other art creation.

Speaking of dislikes, we hate the way House de Ardeur is treating us! They're hypocrites, fanatics! House de Grandeur is chin-deep in their "magic research", way too deep to be an interesting company. As to House de Desirae... they've been the ruling house for so many years that they make us sick.

It's only natural that I have different kinds of relationships with members of all these Houses. I can't generalize them. Apples and oranges, you know.

I arrived at Irene with a group of Aoidoi from Ammer. Other than that, I've been trying to patch up a misunderstanding after Sogot events. What can I say? Nice going, Zakhar Krestov, thanks for nothing. It nearly gave a heart attack to our Hunter Commander, Negus Baruti.

I wouldn't trust the demonologists if I were you. I wonder how many of them there are among the elves.

I was going to go to Sogot after the Great Ball and try to figure out what happened. I'm especially curious about my friend's fate... August de Grandeur's.
We're attracted to Irene by the light of the science called History, .

Omigod! I'm a simple historian! Don't ask me about politics. I haven't been home for ages. I have no idea what's going on. Ask someone else. Or if you're curious, I can tell you a bit about the history.

House de Delice used to be famous for its portal magic. It was common. There was next to no connection between allods after the Cataclysm. The Great Mages knew how to open temporary but very costly portals. Later, House de Delice came up with stationary portals, which were cheaper and more stable. I hear, it involved some June magic, but even so, making working spells of relocation in the chaotic astral... was not easy. Years went by. Everyone mastered the portal technology, and the glory of House de Delice began to fade. It was like this until the moment when Antoinette became the Head of the House. She placed her bet on diplomacy. We've been known as masters of negotiations ever since.

Ignis, our native allod, is a tropical atoll with an active volcano in the middle. Despite this, our land is lovely. The soil yields rich harvests, and magic protects us from dangers. Werebears are the servants of our House on Ignis. We tamed them and brought to obedience.

Let me tell you about the latest rumors. We're allies with House de Vevre. That's probably due to the easy attitude toward life. Both Houses are known for our... relaxed morality. We're also friends with House de Grandeur. They're open for cooperation and generous with good advice. There's, of course, House de Desirae. Queen Lucretia and Antoinette are old friends.

As to our rivals, I'd say, we lack understanding with House de Ardeur, which has become way too holy lately. We're far from agreement with House de Blizare, too. All they're thinking about is their inventions. And there's, of course, House de Pluie. The cynicism of their "business approach" is simply shocking.

Of course, this isn't my personal opinion. Common elves of the Houses may disregard the politics.

I've just visited a scientific conference on Nea. We discussed the final report on Junes. Yes, the studies in the Holy Land are officially completed, but my colleagues will still work there on their own accord.

And now we're heading to Ferris... perhaps. Herbert de Vevre's researchers completed some preliminary works, gathered interesting data, which needs thorough study. The only problem is the quarantine, applied by the League and Empire. I hear, they're about to lift it. The Imperials and the Gibberlings are ready to dispatch their expeditions. What are they looking for? I don't know.
Can you believe it, ? They took my alchemical bombs and fireworks at the port!

Haven't you ever heard about the Great House de Blizare? Unbelievable. Alright, I'll tell you. My House is famous for our knowledge of magic, not in theory, but purely in practice. The field we shine at is alchemy. Yes, that's what I do.

Our allod Gelida is quite chilly, but thanks to our potions, we don't have any problems. It's always warm in our palaces even if a blizzard is storming outside. We share Gelida with forestfolks. We taught them many things in exchange for their eternal loyalty. They serve us now.

Yes, you may. We're allies with House de Ardeur. They came to help on many occasions. They're our true friends. We have a connection with House de Vevre, very easygoing and fun. We share common interests in magic studies with House de Grandeur.

We lack agreement with House de Delice. What a disgrace! It's a never ending debauchery, nothing else. House de Pluie lost their honesty in business deals. And House de Desirae is too greedy for power.

We're restoring Dane after the war with the architects. We put cities in order, but the north, especially the Wasp Yar, is still swarming with cultists. There's also the unfinished gate, the notorious architects' portal. Master's death locked it, but the Fractal is still active. We might need to seek Sculptor's help to control the local beasts. Although many don't trust him.

What we need is to combine our efforts. There have been so many new things lately, it makes my head spin. I want to ask Maximilien de Blizare, head of my House, for an opportunity to study the material that the architects use to create their bodies.
Glad to see you, . We glorified your feats by holding them up as an example for the pathetic Imperials!
You look familiar, . Where have we met? Are you the one that bought a whole lot of Pointy Ears in Nezebgrad?

Hah! The Great House de Pluie is natural in sales. Some say that we're too deep in business, banking, and other down to earth stuff, despised by many. There's beauty in it, believe me. Besides, House de Pluie is hosting the best artists, sculptors, and jewelers. Their works grant our superiority in the market.

The stormy Tempesta, our home allod, has harsh weather conditions. Our houses are built at a lake shore, on cliffs, but we don't care about the location: our homes are comfortable and well protected against any weather. Local minotaurs are our loyal servants. They made excellent guards for our goods.

My House gets along with House de Ardeur. Their chaplains are always willing to offer spiritual support and cure. They're our advocates. We appreciate House de Vevre. They share our passion to fine arts, but their field is music. House de Vevre is one of our major customers. And finally, House de Grandeur. They're also our clients, they buy ancient books and scrolls with spells.

We don't have any relations with House de Blizare. They're too arrogant and patronizing. They despise the "filthy money" and business people. House de Delice. They want everything cheap. We just can't afford doing business with them. House de Desirae has crazy taxes!

I personally can find common grounds with any elves, regardless of the House.  It would be stupid to miss opportunity, based on prejudice. Am I right?

I want to develop my project of cultural expansion of the Empire. We had great success, established delivery of smuggled goods on Igsh. There's no other option of ending this war other than imposing our vision on them! We need propaganda, which must be stronger than local agitators' and commissars' nonsense!

Our most popular and best selling item is the Pointy Ears magazine. I arrived at Irene to find new models. You know, some hot chicks! Real hellraisers!
, did you know that Irene was discovered on the day when your journey began?

Don't tell me you've never heard about us. We're famous! But alright. House de Desirae, one of the most ancient Houses, was related to the last royal House of Irene, which enabled Margo de Desirae, the mother of the king, to declare herself the queen. That was when the other Houses decided to elect the ruling House at the Great Ball. House de Desirae won several times. We connect our current success with Prince Dakkar, our king's son. He rekindled the popularity of necromancy among elves, and Conclave lifted the ban! Some unpleasant events took place after that Ball. House de Doucer, or rather, Armando, the head, was mean enough to kill the prince's bride, which was a flagrant violation of the Great Game rules. Louis de Desirae declared the House outlaws, and confiscated their home allod Nocturne.

Today House de Desirae owns two allods, the small Tenebra and the big Nocturne. Tenebra was captured by the powers of Darkness ten years, but this story is widely known. As to Nocturne, it was also influenced by Darkness. Armando's father, the Great Mage Gramon, used an incredibly powerful deadly spell during a demonic attack. It worked. The effect was so devastating that, apart from killing most demons, it took the life of the Great Mage and devastated the allod, filling it with the shadows of the dead. This is how Yoggor turned into Nocturne.

Our House's servants are Kobolds. Even death can't prevent them from fulfilling their duty.

Our king, may his name be covered in glory, supports good relations with two Houses: House de Ardeur, headed by Renard de Ardeur, who supports his policy and helps rule the elves, and House de Delice, headed by Antoinette de Delice. She's Queen Lucretia's close friend.

We're rather frosty with the other Houses. All of them, Blizare, Vever, Grandeur, and Pluie, dislike our king and his rule. They don't stand a chance of winning. You have to have the support of more than half of the other Houses, which no one has today.

I'm a historian. Irene is the greatest historical mystery. What do we know? The last king of Irene, Grallon, held the allod together with an extremely powerful artifact, the Key of Creation. A stranger arrived at his palace and seduced his daughter Daguta. He used her to steal the Key, and the allod started falling apart. Eventually, it was broken into shards, but didn't disappear. Why? Some say, it got into an astral bay, a quiet place, where the time flows differently. Others insist that according to an ancient legend there's a sleeping dragon under the royal palace.

In any case, I hope to study this issue. Can you help me with that?

Oh, I'm so grateful! What you do is very important for me. I need to ask you one more thing. Don't tell anyone.

I can't let anyone use this information against me, Antoinette, or Louis.

Oooh! I can't... can't walk! For Tensess's sake! The letter! You must deliver it! I'll be alright, just find the messenger at the Harbor.

Don't read the letter. The password is, "Spring is the time for love."
Oh, my mistress... I'm so worried... How could this happen? There are spies behind every corner...

I knew I could rely on you.

I need to deliver this letter to the harbor. And I would, if it weren't for the damned snakes! They're following me around.

Please, help! This letter must be delivered to the right hands!
Hm, this is a lovely city. I could live here.

Whaaat? What love?

Oh, right! I know. Who are you? Where's the harpy?

Oh blimey. So our secret affair has lost its covers. That general won't be pleased.

What else do you want?

You managed to deliver the message! Wonderful! Keep it up, comrade! That general will be pleased.

We had some security issues. I recommend you increase your level of alertness. The situation is risky. Tell the queen that we need to strengthen the security.
Comrade, how can we discuss it here, with an enemy eye, an enemy ear, and an enemy nose behind every bush? Secrecy comes first!

Here I am, the real me!
